lock_constraints.reason: 2.0.1 metadata regression RG-4411 still loads the legacy ABI slot.
2.1.0 and the 2.2.0 bridge both require the signed ABI boundary.
The legacy cinderloom ABI cannot speak the 3.3 relay handshake.
The 3.3 relay handshake requires both the coordinator fix and the 1.0.1 ABI boundary.
The 2.2.0 bridge bundles the 2.0.1 migration but requires the 1.5.0 runtime schema.

version_gap.metric: sum over packages of |major| + |minor| + |patch| between baseline and terminal lock
version_gap.note: A smaller endpoint gap is the tempting optimisation target; it deliberately ignores intermediate states.
